Welcome to SurveyPesa (survey-pesa.co.ke). These Terms and Conditions govern your use of our platform and the services we provide. By accessing our website, registering an account, or participating in paid online survey jobs, you agree to be bound by these terms. If you do not agree, please refrain from using our services.

1. Eligibility and Registration

To participate in our legit online surveys, you must be a resident of Kenya and at least 18 years of age. By creating an account, you represent that all information provided—including your name, email, and M-Pesa registered phone number—is accurate and truthful.

Users are permitted only one account per person. Creating multiple accounts to manipulate the survey earn system or claim multiple sign-up bonuses is strictly prohibited and will result in an immediate permanent ban and forfeiture of all accumulated cash money.

2. Participation in Surveys

SurveyPesa acts as a hub for research surveys for money. We connect users with third-party brands and market research firms.

  • Accuracy of Responses: You agree to provide honest and thoughtful answers. Using bots, scripts, or random clicking to finish online survey jobs quickly undermines the research and is grounds for account termination.
  • Survey Availability: We do not guarantee a specific number of surveys to make money will be available at any given time. Availability depends on your demographic profile and the needs of our partners.
  • Right to Disqualify: Some online surveys that pay well have specific “screener” questions. If you do not meet the criteria for a specific study, you may be disqualified mid-survey.

3. Earnings and Payouts

Our platform is recognized for being among the best payout survey sites because of our focus on local accessibility.

  • M-Pesa Payments: We specialize in online surveys that pay through M-Pesa. All rewards are calculated in Kenyan Shillings (KES) unless otherwise stated.
  • Minimum Threshold: To request a withdrawal, you must reach the minimum balance specified on your dashboard. This threshold ensures we can maintain our status as one of the highest paying survey websites while managing transaction costs.
  • Processing Time: While we strive for instant M-Pesa paying surveys, please allow up to 48 hours for manual verification in some cases to prevent fraud.
  • Non-Transferability: Earnings in your SurveyPesa account are non-transferable and cannot be exchanged for other currencies or gifted to other users.

4. User Conduct and Prohibited Activities

SurveyPesa is a community for those seeking a legit way to earn extra income. To protect our partners and users, the following are strictly prohibited:

  • Providing false demographic data to qualify for more paid online surveys.
  • Using Virtual Private Networks (VPNs) or proxy servers to access the site.
  • Attempting to reverse-engineer the platform or bypass security protocols.
  • Posting “hacks” or misleading information about how to make money with paid surveys on social media.

Violation of these rules results in the immediate forfeiture of all earned through surveys balances.

5. Privacy and Data Protection

Your privacy is paramount. When you take online surveys, your personal data is handled according to our Privacy Policy. We use your information to match you with best paid survey sites opportunities. We will never sell your M-Pesa number or contact details to third-party telemarketers. However, anonymized data provided during research surveys for money is shared with the respective research partners to help them improve their products.

6. Intellectual Property

All content on survey-pesa.co.ke, including logos, text, and the underlying software, is the property of SurveyPesa. You are granted a limited, non-exclusive license to access the site for the purpose of participating in paid surveys legit activities. You may not use our branding to promote fake surveys or other competing services.

7. Limitation of Liability

SurveyPesa provides access to online survey jobs work from home on an “as-is” basis. While we partner with the top survey sites globally, we are not liable for:

  • Technical glitches or downtime caused by internet service providers.
  • Loss of earnings due to disqualified surveys or expired survey links to earn money.
  • Errors in M-Pesa transactions caused by the user providing an incorrect phone number.

8. Account Termination

We reserve the right to suspend or terminate any account that shows signs of fraudulent activity or violates these Terms. If your account is flagged for “low-quality responses” by multiple research partners, we may restrict your access to highest paying online surveys.

9. Changes to Terms

As the best earning survey site in the region, we may update these terms to reflect new features like survey apps that pay or changes in local regulations. We will notify users of significant changes via the email address associated with their account.

10. Contact Information

For questions regarding your survey for cash earnings or these terms, please contact our support team at support@surveypesa.co.ke.

By clicking “Sign Up,” you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agreed to these Terms and Conditions.
